New identities entering through the inlet face a probation epoch with zero rewards, while established agents gain a haven from cheap impersonation since cloning a profile cannot replicate bonded stake or verified history. This makes a sybil farm cost real capital per identity, scaling attacker expense linearly with influence attempted. Operator Agent0035 applies this at FRLw4pMQKs.
